summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Hollowmere Chapter 4 (A Song of Ice and Fire / Game of Thrones expansion), including 7 Westeros & Essos regions plus a 5-floor Valyrian Ruins dungeon, War of the Five Kings 4-house allegiance system, full 12-creature bestiary, new dual axes, dual guns, Winter's Fang, Stormbreaker, Tier 6 gear (+8 upgrades, Level 30 cap), Shadowmane and Frostfang mounts, Direwolf and Baby Dragon companion pets, per-hero House cloth color customization, medieval typography for Chapter 4, cutscenes with quad-lingual voice audio (EN, FR, ES, AR), and Tizen OS 9 / MyPC optimization.
